status: Static conservative carrier concept; no selected article or articulated link mechanism

brochure.revision_scope: Historical 2012 brochure, not a claim of latest production drawing; selection table on physical page 9

reference.radius_datum_scope: Published bend radius refers to pivot-pin centers; this central-path proxy is not registered to actual 3D link channels

geometry.pitch_scope: Nominal arc-length collar stations; adjacent chords are shorter on bends. No rigid ball-joint pitch or manufacturer articulation model.

guide_fit.scope: Deterministic static shape fit in the caller's declared guide frame; no CAD-artifact lookup or continuous shape evolution

limitations: The hollow swept body is a conservative central-path envelope, not the manufacturer's segmented two- or three-channel geometry.
A 10 mm inner diameter is an assumed hose clearance, not a documented channel size.
Decorative collars use nominal arc-length pitch; no rigid links, ball sockets, joints, gravity, strain or torsion are simulated.
The caller supplies source-bound mounting points and separate bare connector leads; this profile does not bind an arm pose.
Length and circular-arc radius fitting alone does not verify self-clearance, robot clearance, mounting strength or dynamic operation.
